text: Implemented coordinate-bearing ordinal, regular, explicit, and categorical axes; standard/custom unit and kind ids; checked lookup; neutral records; coordinate-reporting zero-copy selection; typed malformed/permutation failures; and user-facing contract docs. Shared ScalaCheck/negative/round-trip/removal/permutation/differential tests pass on JVM and Scala.js. Verified 169 unaffected module tests across geometry/core/reference/NIfTI/laws, core and NIfTI optimized Scala.js links, and git diff --check. Aggregate image4s-locus remains intentionally excluded because pre-existing uncommitted adapter edits target a newer locus4s API than the pinned revision; those files were not touched.
